name: New jack punch bass
desc: Punchy new-jack synth bass in C minor: staccato saw-square jabs locking to the swingbeat kick with pitch-snap octave pops on the and-counts. Bobby Brown chart bounce - short, loud and rubbery, chromatic walk into every 4th bar.
